parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the required Node ESM port, .mjs suffixes, manual argv parsing, local-only imports, exact bidict formatting, inverse lookups, update behavior, and executable-based probing.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept primary implementation ownership but spawned children for CLI/repo investigation; the probe child expanded into its own implementation work and spawned a grandchild for bidict semantics.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote formatting, error, parser, ordered bidict, and test8.mjs files, while the probe child separately wrote a different nested module hierarchy and its own test8.mjs into the same output root.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact contained the parent-listed files plus the child-created nested helper tree; the final entrypoint provenance was the shared-output collision point.
parallel.verification: The parent ran sample, parser, duplicate-value, ambiguous-option, and big-integer checks. The child also ran tests and identified unresolved formatter and underscore-integer mismatches in its own module path.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation failed 57/70. The child implementation path was interrupted before its planned patch, and the final artifact retained mixed parent and child helper modules.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual parsing, local import, output-format, no-dependency, and executable-probing requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned discovery, implementation, verification, and final delivery, with no delegation or subagent activity.
serial.implementation: The serial actor wrote one module set for IO, control flow, Python repr, errors, bidict behavior, argparse behavior, runtime handling, and test8.mjs.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact had a single coherent module tree and one entrypoint, with no competing writer or leftover parallel module tree.
serial.verification: The serial actor compared Node output to the executable for samples, help, parser errors, duplicate key/value behavior, quoted strings, and arbitrary-size integers.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation also failed 57/70, but the mounted evidence does not include per-case evaluator failures identifying the remaining defects.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained concurrent probing but allowed the probe child to drift into separate implementation ownership; serial avoided cross-agent ownership ambiguity.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children returned useful CLI and bidict semantics, but no clear output-file ownership contract prevented separate agents from writing the same entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no inter-agent handoff or file ownership interface and directly carried its own findings into the implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key difference is not missing task knowledge but absent coordination around shared output ownership in the parallel run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced a parent implementation with flat helper files and a child implementation with nested helper modules; both targeted `/output/test8.mjs`.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced one nested but internally consistent module set and one `/output/test8.mjs` entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's implementation path diverged into competing trees, while serial's path stayed internally consistent even though both official outputs failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel waited for child progress, listed still-running agents, then interrupted `/root/probe_cli` shortly before final closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it completed its own tests, updated the plan, and returned the final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left an active child path unfinished, while serial had no unjoined child work at closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had concurrent writes into the shared `/output` tree, including competing writes to the required `test8.mjs` entrypoint and leftover helper trees from both actors.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed one file-change event that added one entrypoint and one helper library tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel-specific integration defect is the shared deliverable overwrite and mixed artifact provenance; serial avoided that state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified the parent entrypoint against samples and selected parser/duplicate cases, then finalized despite the interrupted child path and aggregate official failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified a wider coherent set including string formatting edge cases and big integer parity before finalizing, but still failed the official hidden set.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's verification was single-tree and cleaner; parallel verification did not resolve the mixed final tree or child-discovered issues, yet the official aggregate result was equal.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed more agent time and tokens, used four child threads, and closed after interrupting the running probe child rather than incorporating a final child patch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one thread, less wall time, no subagents, and closed after completing its own plan.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's extra budget bought more overlapping work but also produced shared-state cleanup cost; serial was simpler and faster with the same official score.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations report solution_passed false with 57 of 70 samples passed, so the outcome relation is both_fail rather than discordant. The concrete task-solving difference is that serial built and tested one coherent output tree, while parallel let a child and parent both write the required entrypoint and left mixed helper modules after interrupting the child. The mounted evidence does not expose per-testcase evaluator failures, so this coordination defect is retained as adverse process evidence but not as a proven cause of a score difference.

evaluator_effects: Only aggregate official results are mounted; the referenced evaluator cache paths are external evidence strings and were not followed.
